name: windowllm
description: Universal browser LLM API - giving users sovereignty over their AI

scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:chrome --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.build:extension:firefox: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:firefox --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.build:extension:safari: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:safari --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.build:extension:e2e:chrome: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && WINDOWLLM_EXTENSION_E2E=1 npm run build:chrome --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.build:extension:e2e:firefox: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && WINDOWLLM_EXTENSION_E2E=1 npm run build:firefox --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.build:extension:e2e:safari: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && WINDOWLLM_EXTENSION_E2E=1 npm run build:safari:web --workspace=@windowllm/extension
scripts.test:e2e:extension: npm run test:e2e:extension:chrome && npm run test:e2e:extension:firefox && npm run test:e2e:extension:safari

author: WindowLLM Contributors
